'''Detonator ale''' was a type of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage produced by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Species/Legends|species]], sharing its name with the [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]],<ref name="TOR" /> an explosive device.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The [[Ale/Legends|ale]] had violently adverse effects on several species, leading to it being banned throughout most of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "Potable Powder Keg" was released with the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion, it must take place around that year as well.</ref> an individual associated with one of the two warring factions had a companion of theirs smuggle a shipment of detonator ales to the<ref name="TOR" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Detonator ale was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Potable Powder Keg," released as part of the [[2014]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
